page.overview:
Who is General Madelene?

General Madelene is a minor historic character in Final Fantasy IX, only mentioned rarely. She was an Alexandrian general who fought in the 9th Lindblum War in 1389. At the age of 13, General Madelene fought against the Lindblum Army with just nine soldiers under her command. She died in 1401, well before her time.

If Madelene was 13 years old during the Lindblum war in 1389, this means the year of her birth is likely 1376, making her 25 at the time of her death by unknown cause.

A statue to commemorate General Madelene was built at a quadrangle in Alexandria.
